This external resource table was created by Christopher Dean and Erin Dillon to help the community to find relevant palaeobiological resources.

If you notice any issues with this page or wish to add a resource, please contact [Christopher Dean](christopherdaviddean@gmail.com) or [Erin Dillon](emdillon23@gmail.com).

```{r}
library(googlesheets4)
library(reactable)

read_sheet(
  "https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1w0K1gWOBQjMH6q5pYGkY7FNFyBjNt42Pbv9N2JFbquc/edit?gid=0#gid=0"
) |>
  reactable(
    columns = list(
      `Link` = colDef(cell = function(value) {
        htmltools::tags$a(
          href = value,
          target = "_blank",
          value
        )
      })
    ),
    filterable = TRUE,
    searchable = TRUE
  )
```
